info.title: Wyrmgate IAM Identity API
info.description: Runtime public Identity API slice for OD-003. Every operation is gated by trusted control-plane authentication, server-side tenant/governed-actor resolution, and scoped Administrative Authorization.

get.description: Returns authoritative Identity resources ordered deterministically by createdAt, then id. The cursor is opaque to clients.

post.description: Creates exactly one PERSON, SERVICE, or WORKLOAD Identity with a compatible typed profile. This is a semantic create operation, not a persistence-entity API.

Location.description: Canonical URI of the created Identity

post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

patch.description: The first slice permits display-name maintenance only. Lifecycle transitions are intentionally excluded from PATCH and will be modeled as explicit business operations once their command semantics are implemented.
patch.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

get.description: Returns governed canonical resolution state. Provider-native observations, mapping rows, candidate rows, and raw source payloads are not exposed. Attribute values may be redacted according to classification and administrative authorization.

200.description: Canonical attribute page ordered by key, then definitionId

get.x-wyrmgate-authority: Identity canonical authoritative state with provenance summary

post.description: Transitions PENDING, SUSPENDED, or INACTIVE to ACTIVE. A same-state ACTIVE command is a revision-guarded no-op. DECOMMISSIONED is terminal.
post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

post.description: Transitions ACTIVE to SUSPENDED. Loss of access eligibility is authoritative immediately; downstream Access reduction remains asynchronous and Access-owned.
post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

post.description: Transitions PENDING, ACTIVE, or SUSPENDED to INACTIVE. ACTIVE loss of eligibility immediately suppresses semantic EffectiveAccess.
post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

post.description: Transitions PENDING, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, or INACTIVE to terminal DECOMMISSIONED.
post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

get.description: Lists Identity-owned Principal authority. Provider observations are not returned by this resource.
get.x-wyrmgate-pagination: Signed tenant-bound cursor ordered by stable Principal ID

post.description: Explicitly creates one uncorrelated ACCOUNT Principal in ACTIVE technical lifecycle state on an active ApplicationTarget. This is not provider provisioning and does not promote provider observation into authority.
post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

post.summary: Correlate a Principal to one Identity
post.description: Performs one-way explicit Principal correlation. An already correlated Principal cannot be reassigned through this operation.
post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

post.summary: Merge another Identity into the survivor Identity
post.description: Explicitly re-homes Identity-owned current source links and Principals to the path Identity, preserves historical references, and decommissions the absorbed Identity. Foreign-capability authority such as AccessAssignments is not moved.
post.x-wyrmgate-authority: Identity-owned merge operation and relationship history
post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

post.summary: Split selected Identity-owned relationships into a new Identity
post.description: Creates a same-type PENDING Identity and explicitly re-homes only selected current source links and Principals. AccessAssignments and other foreign-capability authority are not copied or moved.

201.description: Identity split completed and new PENDING Identity created

Location.description: URI of the newly created Identity

post.x-wyrmgate-authority: Identity-owned split operation and relationship history
post.x-wyrmgate-idempotency: Required causal idempotency with request-fingerprint conflict detection

controlPlaneBearer.description: Coarse transport authentication only. Resource/action authorization is separately evaluated by IAM Administrative Authorization and defaults to deny.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque deterministic signed continuation cursor. Clients must not construct or interpret it; cursors are tenant/context-bound and time-bounded.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Client-supplied correlation identifier when continuing an existing causal chain. The server returns the effective correlation identifier.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable causal key for a retryable mutation. Reuse with a different normalized request fingerprint is rejected.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong revision ETag returned by the latest authoritative read, for example "rev-7".

RevisionEtag.description: Strong ETag derived from the authoritative semantic revision, for example "rev-7".

CorrelationId.description: Effective correlation identifier for the request chain.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found in the caller's tenant/isolation boundary

CreateIdentityRequest.description: profile.kind must equal type. No profile-specific business attributes are invented in this specification slice.

CanonicalAttributeView.description: values is omitted when visibility is REDACTED or when no readable trusted value exists. CONFLICT/UNRESOLVED may still expose a compatible prior trusted value while the degraded resolutionStatus remains visible.

SplitIdentityRequest.description: At least one sourceRecordIds or principalIds entry is required.

x-wyrmgate-tenant-resolution: Tenant/isolation boundary is derived from authenticated control-plane context, not writable resource fields.
x-wyrmgate-lifecycle-boundary: Identity lifecycle uses explicit semantic operations under ADR-0021; generic PATCH lifecycle/status mutation remains prohibited.
x-wyrmgate-principal-boundary: Principal is Identity-owned technical authority. Public registration is explicit and uncorrelated; provider observations never create Principal authority automatically, correlation is one-way, and provider-driven ACTIVE/DISABLED realization remains internal.
x-wyrmgate-merge-split-boundary: Merge/split are explicit Identity-owned operations under ADR-0026. They preserve Identity-owned relationship history and never move foreign-capability Access/Governance authority.
